9. The case of the defendant No. 9(Ka) to 9(gha) is that Moulvi Amiruddin Dewan, Easin Dewan and Serajuddin. Dewan took settlement of 02 decimals of land from plot No. 402 from the original owner in 1334 B.S. and thereafter, executed a kabuliyat on 6-5-1933 in favour of the sons of Rajkumar. Serajuddin has been possessing his share by a constructing shop and carrying on business there. Thereafter, the land of plot No. 402 was included in hat and vested in the Government. As such, the said land is correctly recorded in SA khatian .No. 504 in the name .of defendant No 9. 

 12. The case of the defendant No 56 is that the suit land originally belonged to Raj Kumar and others. Raj Kumar made an oral gift of 02'/2 decimals of land—from 'plot No. 402 to this defendant. Mohar Ali got settlement of 09 decimals' of land from plot No. 402 from Raj Kutner and also took settlement of 03½ decimals of land from- Raj Kumar by kabuliyat on 19-1-1954; that Mohar Ali sold out the said entire 12½  decimals of land to Ali Akbar who purchased the same 'on behalf of the Masjid Committee. The Masjid committee thus got 12½ decimals of land by oral gift: The Masjid committee possessed the said 15 decimals of land through the defendant Nos. 8;12-44 as Bharatia SA record of right has been correctly prepared in the name' of Masjid committee.
